theorems.name: Submission.varifold_radon_compactness
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (μ : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, μ j (K ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≤ C) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ V : Varifold N n U, ∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ U ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(μ (φ j))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ z, f z ∂V.measure))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
